patterns.note: Content is primarily centered within a consistent max-width container, but hero and footer sections extend full-bleed with background elements.
A distinctive, elegant display serif font is used for primary headings and key statements, paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation.

The site uses a sophisticated palette of muted, earthy tones, primarily a dark charcoal for text and footer, a soft off-white for backgrounds, and subtle gradient shifts in hero sections, accented by a vibrant orange for calls to action.

The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground text. The header transforms on scroll, replacing a simple CTA with a full navigation menu that sticks to the top. A very large, stylized 'airtree' logo is revealed at the very bottom of the page as the user scrolls to the end.
Key information like partner logos, company statistics, and blog posts are presented in horizontal carousels or grid layouts, emphasizing discoverability and visual flow.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a background image that moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a depth-of-field parallax effect as the user scrolls. This could be achieved with CSS transforms or a JavaScript library like GSAP ScrollTrigger.

The header dynamically changes its content and styling based on scroll position. Initially, it shows a logo and a 'Get in touch' button. After scrolling, the button is replaced by a full navigation menu that remains sticky at the top of the viewport. This transformation likely uses JavaScript to add/remove classes or modify styles based on scroll events.

Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, giving a smooth, progressive loading experience. This is a common pattern for scroll-triggered animations, often implemented with Intersection Observer API and CSS transitions or a library like GSAP.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, complemented by a legible sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, with sharp corners for most content blocks and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with airy hero and testimonial sections, transitioning to a more compact grid for blog posts and partner logos.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with a sophisticated, almost editorial aesthetic for a venture capital firm, eschewing typical tech-bro design. The use of an elegant display serif font for key statements, combined with subtle gradient backgrounds and a transforming sticky header, creates a refined and authoritative feel. The dramatic, full-width logo reveal at the very bottom of the page provides a memorable and unique brand signature.
